{{Youmay|a [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] position|[[Political Reliability Observer]]}}
A '''political officer''' was a member of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] assigned to oversee the continued [[Politics/Legends|political]] loyalty of other officers.

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Suba (lieutenant)/Legends|Suba]] was the political officer aboard [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], responsible for ensuring the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] loyalty of his fellow officers.<ref name="Dagobah">''{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Suba}}''</ref>
